events:commute_y1_missed_bus.title: Missed the Bus
events:commute_y1_missed_bus.text: The bus doors closed right in front of you. The next bus is in 15 minutes, and first period starts in 20.
events:commute_y1_missed_bus.options.spr: Totally out of breath, but you made it right before the bell!
events:commute_y1_missed_bus.options.bik: A passing friend offered you the back seat. The morning breeze feels amazing!
Not one familiar face rode by. Late after all.
events:commute_y1_missed_bus.options.nex: You gazed out the window to your heart's content. The tardy mark was a free bonus.
events:commute_y1_grandma.title: Grandma's Heavy Load
events:commute_y1_grandma.text: On the hill to school, a grandma is struggling to haul a big cart up the slope.
events:commute_y1_grandma.options.pull.r: At the top of the hill, she pressed a handful of candy into your hand.
events:commute_y1_grandma.options.togeth: Heave-ho, all together! A passing teacher gave you a thumbs-up.
Everyone was “too busy” and walked on. You struggled alone until you ran out of steam.
events:commute_y1_grandma.options.ignore: You turned up your earbuds. What a quiet morning.
events:commute_y2_homework.title: Lemme See Your Homework
events:commute_y2_homework.text: At the school gate, a friend clasps their hands. “Just 5 minutes with your math homework, please!”
events:commute_y2_homework.options.expla: Explaining it made you really get it, too.
events:commute_y2_homework.options.baske: Buzzer-beater! Your friend decided to do the homework on their own.
The ball circled the rim and popped out. You lost the bet and handed over your homework.
events:commute_y2_homework.options.refus: “Do it yourself!” Wow, saying that felt good.
events:commute_y2_running_crew.title: Morning Running Crew
events:commute_y2_running_crew.text: A running crew in neon vests has gathered in the park on your way to school. They wave you over to join.
events:commute_y2_running_crew.options.r: Your legs are wobbly, but your head is crystal clear.
events:commute_y2_running_crew.options.t: 3rd place in the crew race! You walked into school with a medal around your neck.
You got a side stitch halfway. Finishing is what counts.
events:commute_y2_running_crew.options.c: The crew shared bananas to thank you for cheering.
events:commute_y2_running_crew.options.t: The coach looked at your time and nodded. You made the team!
Missed it by just 0.3 seconds. Next time for sure!
events:commute_y3_flyer.title: Flyer Gig at the Gate
events:commute_y3_flyer.text: The owner of the local snack bar, handing out flyers, asks if you can help for a bit. There's a tip in it for you.
events:commute_y3_flyer.options.hand_out: You said “hello” about a hundred times. Earned ₩5,000!
events:commute_y3_flyer.options.pitch.re: Your witty lines made everyone smile and grab one. A fat tip!
Everyone walked past with earbuds in. All you got was a sore throat.
“Sorry, I've got a test first period!” And through the gate you went.
events:commute_y1_closing_gate.title: The Closing Gate
events:commute_y1_closing_gate.text: 8:29. The discipline teacher is slowly pushing the school gate shut. 50 meters to go!
events:commute_y1_closing_gate.options.s: Slide in with all you've got
The knees of your uniform are covered in dirt, but… safe!
events:commute_y1_closing_gate.options.g: “Love the tie today, sir!” He laughed and waved you in.
“Thanks for the greeting. Still late.” Your name went on the list.
events:commute_y1_closing_gate.options.w: You're late anyway. Might as well enjoy the morning sun.
events:classroom_y1_group_project.title: The Ghosting Teammate
events:classroom_y1_group_project.text: It's group presentation day, and one teammate has gone totally off the grid.
events:classroom_y1_group_project.option: You finished 20 slides late into the night. You did it.
Your teammate apologized and handed over their part.
The presentation was over in a flash. Eh, these things happen.
The teacher heard you out and praised you for working so hard on your own.
events:classroom_y1_class_president.text: The first class meeting of the new semester. When nominations opened, someone shouted your name!
events:classroom_y1_class_president.opti: Your “Fair Cleaning Duty Lottery” pledge became the talk of the class group chat.
The room burst into applause. You're class president! Your homeroom teacher is beaming.
Nerves tied your tongue in knots. You lost by just 2 votes.
Your friend gave you a shout-out in their victory speech.
events:classroom_y2_snack_shop.title: Snack Stand Pitch
events:classroom_y2_snack_shop.text: To raise class funds, your deskmate suggested selling snacks during breaks. Your homeroom teacher even said yes.
events:classroom_y2_snack_shop.options.l: Make price tags and a ledger
Cost, price, profit—all neatly laid out in a table.
events:classroom_y2_snack_shop.options.s: Sold out every single break! You got ₩15,000 for your trouble.
The Choco Pies melted in the sun. You ate all the leftovers yourself.
events:classroom_y2_snack_shop.options.b: Snacks you pay for just taste better.
events:classroom_y2_council_meeting.text: The student council meeting about the festival budget drags on. Everyone seems to be waiting for your opinion.
events:classroom_y2_council_meeting.opti: You filled every cell with numbers. As of today, you're the treasurer.
Passed unanimously! Even the head of student affairs praised you.
Opinions split right down the middle. Meeting postponed to next week.
Over spicy tteokbokki, everyone became friends in no time.
events:classroom_y2_lend_notes.title: Lend Me Your Notes
events:classroom_y2_lend_notes.text: A week before exams, your classmates are lining up to borrow your notes.
events:classroom_y2_lend_notes.options.c: Organizing them turned into a free review session.
events:classroom_y2_lend_notes.options.s: Everyone in the group improved! Word even reached the teachers.
The study group turned into a gossip club. Not a single page got done.
events:classroom_y2_lend_notes.options.l: You decided to put your own studying first. What a relief.
events:classroom_y2_lend_notes.options.s: The teacher pinpointed just the essentials. Your head feels clearer.
events:classroom_y3_career_talk.title: Career Talk Class
events:classroom_y3_career_talk.text: You have to give a 5-minute talk on “Me in 10 Years.” Your turn is coming up.
Photos, graphs, even a video. Just looking at them makes you proud.
The whole class laughed and clapped. Even the teacher gave a thumbs-up!
Your mind went blank. 5 minutes felt like 50.
Done and dusted in 3 minutes. Safe is best.
You announced your candidacy at the end, and the room went wild. And then you won!
Your courage got applause, but you narrowly lost the election.
events:classroom_y1_self_study.title: Self-Study Temptation
events:classroom_y1_self_study.text: The supervising teacher left for a meeting. A quiet classroom, warm sunshine, heavy eyelids…
events:classroom_y1_self_study.options.w: You finished a whole unit. Victory over drowsiness!
events:classroom_y1_self_study.options.q: You were an amazing host! Everyone's stomach hurt from laughing silently.
The teacher came back. Written apologies for everyone…
events:classroom_y1_self_study.options.n: You woke up with a textbook print on your arm.
events:classroom_y1_self_study.options.o: A perfect score on the past papers! The teacher wrote you an olympiad recommendation.
You got stuck on the last problem. Still, you learned a lot.
events:library_y1_new_books.title: New Arrivals Shelf
events:library_y1_new_books.text: A pile of new books just arrived at the library. That fresh-book smell tickles your nose.
events:library_y1_new_books.options.intr: It was tough, but you're starting to see what you want to study.
events:library_y1_new_books.options.essa: Grand prize! Your essay is posted on the library board.
You turned it in 1 minute before the deadline. Result: participation award.
events:library_y1_new_books.options.comi: You binged five volumes of a series in one go. Pure bliss.
events:library_y1_window_doodle.title: Window Seat Doodles
events:library_y1_window_doodle.text: A window seat in the library. The doodle in the corner of your scratch pad looks better than expected.
After copying one masterpiece, your lines look totally different.
Gold prize! The moment a doodle becomes a masterpiece.
Judges' comment: “Original, but unrelated to the theme.”
A cloud looked just like a whale. Your heart went all soft.
events:library_y2_invention.title: Invention Contest Poster
events:library_y2_invention.text: A youth invention contest poster went up at the library entrance. The grand prize comes with help filing a patent!
events:library_y2_invention.options.pate: You learned how to read a patent spec. Head throbbing, eyes sparkling.
events:library_y2_invention.options.subm: Your “Auto Umbrella Dryer” won a prize! You even got a patent consultation.
Something just like it already existed. On to the next idea!
events:library_y2_invention.options.idea: You laughed for ages over totally ridiculous ideas.
events:library_y2_invention.options.olym: You represented the school and won silver! The principal shook your hand.
The problems were harder than expected. At least you got the experience.
events:library_y2_webnovel.title: Web Novel Workshop
events:library_y2_webnovel.text: An after-school web novel class opened at the library. Even the first sentence feels impossible.
events:library_y2_webnovel.options.daily: Day ten of your serial. Your sentences keep getting smoother.
events:library_y2_webnovel.options.uploa: Post it on a web novel site
Over 10,000 views! Your classmates are begging for the next chapter.
3 views. And 2 of them were you.
events:library_y2_webnovel.options.read_: Turns out novels other people write are the most fun.
events:library_y3_study_room.title: Study Room Seat Wars
events:library_y3_study_room.text: CSAT D-100. The battle for a seat in the library study room is fierce.
events:library_y3_study_room.options.unt: You held out until the librarian turned off the lights.
events:library_y3_study_room.options.tut: Your junior's score jumped 20 points! Word reached the teachers, too.
You got confused while explaining. Time to study it again together.
events:library_y3_study_room.options.giv: Give your seat to a friend
Your friend bought you a drink as thanks.
events:library_y3_portfolio.title: Portfolio Prep
events:library_y3_portfolio.text: Time to put together your admissions portfolio. Plenty of work, but the description boxes are blank.
events:library_y3_portfolio.options.capt: Once every piece had a story, it all looked way more legit.
events:library_y3_portfolio.options.exhi: The guestbook filled up on day one. Best Exhibit award!
Applications had already closed. You hung your work on your bedroom wall instead.
events:library_y3_portfolio.options.stro: One lap around the field, and your head felt clear.
events:field_y1_dodgeball.title: Sports Day Dodgeball
events:field_y1_dodgeball.text: The sports day dodgeball prelims are right around the corner. The class group chat is buzzing with strategy.
events:field_y1_dodgeball.options.lunch_: Dodging balls now feels as natural as dancing.
events:field_y1_dodgeball.options.ace.re: You survived to the end for a comeback win! Your classmates tossed you in the air.
Out on the very first throw. Still, the cheering section was so warm.
You cheered until you were hoarse. You feel much closer to your classmates.
events:field_y1_dodgeball.options.relay_: As the anchor, you passed two runners! Sports day MVP!
You almost dropped the baton. A nail-biting 2nd place.
events:field_y1_festival_rehearsal.title: Festival Stage Rehearsal
events:field_y1_festival_rehearsal.text: A festival stage went up on the field. They're short on people for the rehearsal and sent out an SOS.
events:field_y1_festival_rehearsal.optio: The cardboard castle looks like the real deal. Your hands are covered in paint.
A last-minute fill-in, and the applause poured in! Are you a natural on stage?
You mixed up the blocking and turned the wrong way. Everyone laughed anyway.
You waved a light stick and had a total blast.
The crowd screamed for an encore! You won the festival's Most Popular award!
The backing track cut out, but you held on till the end. Give yourself a hand.
events:field_y2_festival_booth.title: Festival Booth Crew
events:field_y2_festival_booth.text: They're recruiting crews for the festival food booths. Every class is already fighting over menus.
events:field_y2_festival_booth.options.c: ₩300 profit per cup. Your calculator is running hot.
events:field_y2_festival_booth.options.b: Your voice drew a long line. Your share of the profit: ₩10,000!
The booth next door had a better hype person. All the customers went their way…
events:field_y2_festival_booth.options.f: Go on a booth food tour
Chicken skewers, slushies, waffles. Today is a full-belly day.
events:field_y2_festival_booth.options.r: Sold out and #1 in sales! You won Best Booth and got the profits.
You bought way too many ingredients. The leftovers became class snacks.
events:field_y2_mural.title: The Field Mural
events:field_y2_mural.text: A notice went up: they're looking for students to paint a mural on the old wall by the field.
events:field_y2_mural.options.paint.resu: You've gotten used to the paint smell. The wall is slowly coming to life.
events:field_y2_mural.options.design_con: Your design won! Your name is painted small in one corner of the wall.
So close—2nd place. You got to paint the sky part instead.
events:field_y2_mural.options.visit_late: You snapped the photo of a lifetime in front of the finished mural.
events:field_y3_tug_of_war.title: The Last Tug-of-War
events:field_y3_tug_of_war.text: Your last sports day as a Year 3. The event: classic tug-of-war. Everyone's eyes are full of grim determination.
events:field_y3_tug_of_war.options.train: Your palms are covered in calluses. Your form is national-team level.
events:field_y3_tug_of_war.options.cheer: Your cheer routine won the Spirit award! The video is going around everywhere.
You forgot the choreography. But for sheer volume, you were #1.
events:field_y3_tug_of_war.options.photo: 200 group photos alone. Every single one is a precious memory.
events:field_y1_flea_market.title: Flea Market on the Field
events:field_y1_flea_market.text: There's a flea market on the school field this weekend. Maybe sell some stuff you don't use?
events:field_y1_flea_market.options.poli: Your sparkly-clean items sold fast. Earned ₩5,000!
events:field_y1_flea_market.options.hagg: Haggling success! Your old game console sold for ₩15,000.
You kept knocking the price down until there was nothing left to earn.
events:field_y1_flea_market.options.brow: You lost track of time looking at nostalgic old toys.
events:club_band_jam.title: Off-Beat Jam Session
events:club_band_jam.text: At band practice, the drums and guitar keep falling out of sync. Only 3 weeks until the festival.
events:club_band_jam.options.practice.re: On the hundredth try, the beat finally locked in.
events:club_band_jam.options.play.label: Karaoke with the band
events:club_band_jam.options.play.result: Turns out you all sync up better at karaoke than in the practice room.
events:club_band_jam.options.challenge.r: They even called for an encore! Grand prize in the band contest!
A guitar string snapped. You played to the end anyway.
events:club_band_busking.title: Busking Invite
events:club_band_busking.text: A senior asks you to busk with them in the park this weekend. Your first time in front of a real audience.
events:club_band_busking.options.practic: Your fingertips sting, but you've got the new song down perfectly.
events:club_band_busking.options.play.re: Over tteokbokki, the setlist for the next show was decided.
events:club_band_busking.options.challen: People stopped in their tracks to listen. You placed in the local busking contest!
Nerves made you miss the first line. You'll nail it next time.
events:club_art_still_life.title: Still Life Class
events:club_art_still_life.text: The art club teacher set out three apples. Today's theme: “Light and Shadow.”
events:club_art_still_life.options.pract: You learned how to make light with just the tip of a pencil.
Halfway through squeezing out paint, the chatter took over.
events:club_art_still_life.options.chall: Selected! Your painting is hanging in the city hall lobby.
The paint wasn't dry and it smeared. Hey, that's art too.
events:club_art_festival_poster.title: Festival Poster Request
events:club_art_festival_poster.text: The student council asked the art club to make the festival poster. Deadline: this Friday!
Out of five drafts, you totally love one.
A nap surrounded by the smell of paint was surprisingly sweet.
Your poster won the grand prize! It's up all over the school.
You missed the deadline by 10 minutes. Next time.
events:club_drama_script.title: Script Read-Through
events:club_drama_script.text: The drama club's first script reading. Your lines alone fill ten pages.
events:club_drama_script.options.practic: Now your lines pop out even when you talk in your sleep.
events:club_drama_script.options.play.re: You laughed so hard you thought you'd burst.
events:club_drama_script.options.challen: The audience gave a standing ovation. You won an acting award!
The prop door wouldn't open. You ad-libbed through it, but still…
events:club_drama_audition.title: Casting Auditions
events:club_drama_audition.text: Audition day for the big show. Five people are going for the one role you want.
events:club_drama_audition.options.pract: Thanks to belly breathing, your voice reached the back of the auditorium.
Wiping off makeup, you saw each other's faces and cracked up.
events:club_drama_audition.options.chall: You got the lead! The show sold out, and you won Best Actor too!
You got a supporting role. Just one line, but it got the biggest laugh.
events:club_dance_mirror.title: Perfect Sync Practice
events:club_dance_mirror.text: Eight people match one move in front of the mirror. Only your arm angle keeps coming out different.
events:club_dance_mirror.options.practic: Finally, the eight people in the mirror moved as one.
events:club_dance_mirror.options.play.re: One ice cream, and your tiredness melted right away.
events:club_dance_mirror.options.challen: Perfectly in sync! Honorable mention at the youth dance contest!
The music started late and threw off the beat. Next time for sure!
events:club_dance_challenge_video.title: Dance Challenge Video
events:club_dance_challenge_video.text: The dance club is filming a challenge video to promote the school. Who gets to be center?
events:club_dance_challenge_video.option: Your new choreo is a huge hit in the club.
The bloopers are a hundred times funnier than the real video.
The crowd roared when the opening act ended. You won the Performance award!
A costume string came loose. You still finished with a smile.
events:club_ball_league.title: School League
events:club_ball_league.text: The after-school soccer and basketball league has started. Starting spots are on the line.
events:club_ball_league.options.practice: Your ankles ache, but your shooting just clicked.
events:club_ball_league.options.play.res: Cup noodles after a good sweat are the best food in the world.
events:club_ball_league.options.challeng: You scored the winning goal! Regional champions!
A heartbreaking loss in overtime. Everyone patted each other on the back.
events:club_ball_rainy_day.title: Rainy Day Training
events:club_ball_rainy_day.text: Rain suddenly pours down. The coach says today's practice is in the gym.
events:club_ball_rainy_day.options.pract: 100 burpees. Your legs don't feel like yours anymore.
Rest and listen to the rain
You listened to the rain under the eaves with your teammates.
events:club_ball_rainy_day.options.chall: A comeback buzzer-beater! You took home the friendly match MVP trophy!
The wet ball caused lots of mistakes. Let's do better next time.
events:club_science_experiment.title: The Failing Experiment
events:club_science_experiment.text: The science club's experiment failed again. The solution in the beaker is a weird color, as usual.
events:club_science_experiment.options.p: You changed one variable, and finally got results!
You saw Saturn's rings through the rooftop telescope.
events:club_science_experiment.options.c: Gold at the science fair! The judges asked you three whole questions.
Your setup tipped over mid-presentation. Bring tape next time.
events:club_science_water_rocket.title: Water Rocket Launch
events:club_science_water_rocket.text: Science Day means a water rocket contest. Your team's best test launch so far: 0m.
events:club_science_water_rocket.options: You even factored in air resistance. In theory, it's perfect.
You won the snacks in a paper airplane distance bet.
Your rocket flew to the far end of the field! Top prize!
The rocket spun around and landed right at the principal's feet.
events:club_coding_bug.title: The Never-Ending Bug
events:club_coding_bug.text: The night before the coding club's project deadline. One bug just won't go away.
The culprit was a single semicolon. Anticlimactic, but satisfying.
events:club_coding_bug.options.play.resu: “Just one round” turned into three. Still, you feel refreshed.
events:club_coding_bug.options.challenge: Excellence award at the youth hackathon! Your app got demoed on stage.
The server crashed right before the demo. Still, you learned a lot.
events:club_coding_lunch_app.title: The School Lunch App
events:club_coding_lunch_app.text: Someone pitched an app that shows the school lunch menu. Everyone's eyes lit up.
events:club_coding_lunch_app.options.pra: The problem you couldn't solve yesterday clicks today.
events:club_coding_lunch_app.options.pla: The chicken went cold while you argued over the app's name.
events:club_coding_lunch_app.options.cha: The lunch app won a prize! The whole school uses your app now.
On judging day, the menu wouldn't load. Of all days.
events:club_broadcast_lunch_show.title: 5 Minutes to Air
events:club_broadcast_lunch_show.text: 5 minutes before the lunch broadcast, the host is absent. The mic has landed in front of you.
events:club_broadcast_lunch_show.options: A whole hour of pronunciation drills. Your tongue doesn't trip anymore.
Reading listeners' stories got everyone a little teary.
You won the announcer category at the youth broadcasting contest!
You missed the cue: 3 seconds of dead air. Watch for it next time.
events:club_broadcast_interview.title: Interviewing the Principal
events:club_broadcast_interview.text: The broadcast club booked an interview with the principal for a special. The question sheet is still blank.
Ten questions, sharpened to a point.
Chill to music in the booth
You blasted your favorite songs and had a good long rest.
Your interview video won an award in the education office contest!
Nobody pressed record. You'll have to shoot it again.
events:club_startup_pitch.title: Idea Pitch
events:club_startup_pitch.text: Pitch day at the startup club. You get just 3 minutes!
events:club_startup_pitch.options.practi: Add some tables and graphs and it looks like a real company.
events:club_startup_pitch.options.play.r: In the name of “market research,” you ate every new snack.
events:club_startup_pitch.options.challe: Honorable mention at the youth startup contest! A judge gave you their business card.
The barrage of questions left you speechless. Time to study your numbers.
events:club_startup_goods.title: School Merch
events:club_startup_goods.text: Someone proposed making and selling school mascot merch. The budget is tight.
events:club_startup_goods.options.practi: You found a way to cut the unit cost by ₩100!
events:club_startup_goods.options.play.r: The mascot keychain is way cuter than expected.
events:club_startup_goods.options.challe: The mascot merch won a prize! Orders are pouring in.
The sample came out a weird color. Double-check next time.
traits:talent.name: Gifted
traits:talent.desc: A natural genius whose brain runs at top speed. But gets bored easily.
traits:effort.name: Hard Worker
traits:effort.desc: The icon of grit who always gets back up. Always a little tired, though.
traits:effort.ability: Study +2 even on a failed Study check
traits:athlete.name: Athlete
traits:athlete.desc: A Stamina champ who sweats every worry away. Sitting at a desk is a bit tough.
traits:insider.name: Social Butterfly
traits:insider.desc: Knows someone everywhere they go. Feels bad saying no to a favor.
traits:insider.ability: Twice a year, use Social for any check
traits:insider.weakness: Stress +10 when turning down a favor
traits:lucky.name: Lucky Duck
traits:lucky.desc: Things just mysteriously work out for this one. The skills? Still up for debate.
traits:lucky.ability: Twice a year, turn a Fumble into a normal Fail

vacations:summer.title: Summer Break
vacations:summer.text: Summer break at last! How will you spend the next month and a half?
vacations:summer.options.parttime.label: 🏪 Part-time job
vacations:summer.options.parttime.result: Money you earned with your own sweat really is the sweetest.
vacations:summer.options.parttime.desc: Night shifts at a convenience store
vacations:summer.options.academy.label: 📚 Cram school intensive
vacations:summer.options.academy.resultT: You powered through the material in a blissfully air-conditioned classroom.
vacations:summer.options.academy.desc: Sign up for a summer intensive
vacations:summer.options.practice_sports: You got super tanned, but your body feels light as a feather.
vacations:summer.options.practice_arts.r: Doing what you love made the time fly.
vacations:summer.options.practice_arts.d: All day long in the studio
vacations:summer.options.play.label: 🏖️ Play all you want
vacations:summer.options.play.resultText: You played with zero regrets. Battery at 100%!
vacations:winter.title: Winter Break
vacations:winter.text: The year is over. It's winter break before the new school year—what will you do?
vacations:winter.options.parttime.label: 🏪 Short-term job
vacations:winter.options.parttime.result: Your hands are chapped, but your bank account is happy.
vacations:winter.options.parttime.desc: Loading parcels in the year-end rush
vacations:winter.options.prestudy.label: 📚 Study ahead
vacations:winter.options.prestudy.result: The new textbooks already feel familiar.
vacations:winter.options.trip.label: 🧳 Family trip
vacations:winter.options.trip.resultText: Your photo album is packed with memories.
vacations:winter.options.trip.desc: A family outing, at long last
vacations:winter.options.practice_sports: You ran and ran, puffing out frosty breath.
vacations:winter.options.practice_arts.r: A finished piece now sits in the corner of your room.
exams:strategies.cram.label: 🌙 All-night cramming
exams:strategies.normal.label: ✏️ Steady as usual
exams:strategies.condition.label: 🧘 Take care of yourself
exams:regular.text: Exam season is here. What's your strategy?
exams:regular.success.text: It went smoother than you expected. Your grades went up!
exams:regular.critical.text: Near-perfect scores in every subject! The teachers are taking notice.
exams:regular.fail.text: Even the questions you knew tripped you up. One look at your report card and you sigh.
exams:final.title: Career Exam
exams:final.text: Year 3, second semester. This is the exam that decides your real path.
exams:final.types.academic.name: The CSAT
exams:final.types.academic.text: The fruit of 12 years of studying: the morning of the CSAT has dawned.
exams:final.types.sports.name: Skills Test
exams:final.types.sports.text: The air in the gym is tense. It's your turn for the skills test.
exams:final.types.arts.name: Audition
exams:final.types.arts.text: Three judges sit before you. The lights come on.
exams:final.types.comm.name: Interview
exams:final.types.comm.text: You're at the interview room door. Your name is called.
exams:final.types.biz.name: Startup Pitch
exams:final.types.biz.text: You present your business plan to a room full of investors.
exams:final.success.text: You did it! You showed them everything you prepared.
exams:final.fail.text: Nerves made you slip up. It leaves a bit of regret.

endings:miracles.casting.name: Street-Scouted Actor
endings:miracles.casting.text: On graduation day, an agency that saw your festival video got in touch. Just like that, your debut was set.
endings:miracles.viral.name: Viral Star Creator
endings:miracles.viral.text: Your video on the school's social media went nationwide. 1 million subscribers—and now it's your job.
endings:miracles.contest.name: Inventor & Founder
endings:miracles.contest.text: The idea you entered in that contest got patented. Investment offers lined up at your door.
endings:rescue.co_founder.name: Co-Founder
endings:rescue.co_founder.call: “Hey, I got funding! Nobody looks out for people like you do. Let's do this together!”
endings:rescue.singer_manager.name: Singer's Manager
endings:rescue.singer_manager.call: “I'm making my debut, and you're the only one I trust. Will you be my manager?”
endings:rescue.channel_pd.name: Channel Producer
endings:rescue.channel_pd.call: “Our channel blew up! We need someone to plan content, and you're perfect for it.”
endings:rescue.club_staff.name: Pro Team Staff
endings:rescue.club_staff.call: “I just signed with a pro team! They're hiring staff, and I recommended you!”
endings:rescue.corporate_pr.name: Corporate PR Rep
endings:rescue.corporate_pr.call: “There's an opening on our company's PR team. You're such a smooth talker—I thought of you right away.”
endings:rescue.cafe_partner.name: Café Co-Owner
endings:rescue.cafe_partner.call: “Remember when we were little and said we'd open a café? Let's actually do it.”
endings:explore.name: Still Finding Myself
endings:explore.text: You took a gap year to travel the world. You decided to go find yourself out on the road.
endings:failScene.0: The roulette wheel stopped on “Still Finding Myself.”
endings:failScene.1: You got your diploma, but you still don't know what you want to do.
endings:failScene.2: One by one, your friends set off down their own paths.
endings:epilogue.burnout: Burnout alert! You've decided to do nothing but sleep for a month after graduation.
endings:epilogue.money: With the money you saved up, you went on a solo graduation trip.
surprise:surprise_leak.title: Leaked Exam Rumor
surprise:surprise_leak.text: “I heard the exam got leaked!” A shady rumor is going around the hallway. Real deal, or just gossip?
surprise:surprise_leak.label: Check out the rumor
surprise:surprise_leak.resultText.succes: Turns out it was just the key material the teacher kept stressing. You got a solid review out of it!
surprise:surprise_leak.resultText.fail: Just a fake rumor. You got worked up for nothing.
surprise:surprise_lottery.title: Festival Raffle
surprise:surprise_lottery.text: The festival's grand finale: the raffle draw! The number in your hand is 77.
surprise:surprise_lottery.label: Clasp your hands and pray
surprise:surprise_lottery.resultText.suc: “Number 77!” You won a ₩20,000 gift card! You're already planning how to spend it.
surprise:surprise_lottery.resultText.fai: The person next to you won. You clapped extra hard for them.
surprise:surprise_pop_quiz.title: Pop Quiz!
surprise:surprise_pop_quiz.text: “Close your books. Pop quiz.” With those words from the teacher, the whole classroom froze.
surprise:surprise_pop_quiz.label: Unleash your guessing skills
surprise:surprise_pop_quiz.resultText.su: Every single guess was right! The teacher praised you.
surprise:surprise_pop_quiz.resultText.fa: Your answer sheet is basically blank. Looks like a review night.
surprise:surprise_gym_clothes.title: Forgot My Gym Clothes
surprise:surprise_gym_clothes.text: 5 minutes before PE, your locker is empty. You left your gym clothes at home!
surprise:surprise_gym_clothes.label: Borrow from the next class
surprise:surprise_gym_clothes.resultText: Someone in the next class happily lent you theirs. You made a new friend, too.
All that running around made you late for class. Punishment: two laps around the field.
surprise:surprise_casting.title: Spotted by an Agency
surprise:surprise_casting.text: Rumor has it a talent agency saw the festival video and contacted the school. Could it be… you?
surprise:surprise_casting.label: Wait for the call
surprise:surprise_casting.resultText.suc: “Do you have a minute?” A business card landed in your hand.
surprise:surprise_casting.resultText.fai: It was about some other school. Still, your heart fluttered all day.
surprise:surprise_viral.title: I'm on the School's Socials!
surprise:surprise_viral.text: You're front and center in the festival video on the school's social media. The comments are starting to roll in.
surprise:surprise_viral.label: Open the comments
surprise:surprise_viral.resultText.succe: 100K views! You became a school celebrity overnight.
surprise:surprise_viral.resultText.fail: Of all the frames, the thumbnail caught you mid-blink. So embarrassing…
surprise:surprise_relay.title: Surprise Relay Runner
surprise:surprise_relay.text: A relay runner dropped out with an upset stomach! Your homeroom teacher is pointing at you.
surprise:surprise_relay.label: Take the baton
surprise:surprise_relay.resultText.succe: You passed two runners and crossed the finish line! The whole class went wild.
surprise:surprise_relay.resultText.fail: Your sneaker flew off the second you started. Your leg is throbbing.
cafeteria:title: Cafeteria
cafeteria:outcomes.special.title: Special Menu Today!
cafeteria:outcomes.special.text: Fried chicken for school lunch! The line was long, but so worth the wait.
cafeteria:outcomes.disliked.title: The Dreaded Side Dish
cafeteria:outcomes.disliked.text: Right in the middle of your tray: a mountain of seasoned eggplant, your least favorite.
cafeteria:outcomes.chat.title: Chatting with Friends
cafeteria:outcomes.chat.text: 10 minutes to eat, 30 minutes of chatting and counting. Lunch break is way too short.
cafeteria:outcomes.walk.title: After-Lunch Stroll
cafeteria:outcomes.walk.text: You ate your fill and walked a lap around the field. Great for digestion.
cafeteria:treat.title: Snacks on Me!
cafeteria:treat.text: Your wallet is nice and full. Your friends are staring at you with sparkly eyes.
cafeteria:treat.options.treat.label: 🍩 Treat friends to snacks
cafeteria:treat.options.treat.resultText: School store ice cream flex! You're today's most popular person.
cafeteria:treat.options.skip.label: 🙅 Next time's on me
“Next time, for real!” All you left them was a promise.
counsel:title: Counseling Room
counsel:texts.0: The school counselor smiles and hands you a cup of warm cocoa.
counsel:texts.1: “How have things been lately? Talk to me—no pressure.”
counsel:texts.2: Afternoon sunlight streams in between the potted plants by the window. You feel a little more at ease.
counsel:texts.3: What should we talk about today?
counsel:options.stat.label: 💪 Build up your stats
counsel:options.stat.desc: +4 to a base stat of your choice
counsel:options.career.label: 🧭 Get career counseling
counsel:options.career.desc: +3 Career path EXP of your choice
counsel:options.rest.label: 🫖 Let it all out
counsel:options.rest.resultText.done: After opening up, your heart feels so much lighter.
counsel:options.roadmap.label: 🗺️ Map out your career
counsel:options.roadmap.desc: Career path of your choice +3, Stress −10
nurse:title: Nurse's Office
nurse:stressRelief.text: The school nurse hands you a warm cup of tea and tells you to lie down for a bit. You feel all the tension melt away.
nurse:heal.text: The nurse said you looked pale and offered you a bed. After a quick nap, you feel recharged.
nurse:quiz.text: The nurse seems bored and pops a health quiz on you. “How many hours of sleep should you get a day?”
nurse:quiz.option.label: 🩺 Take the health quiz
nurse:quiz.option.resultText.success: Correct! The nurse gave you a vitamin candy as a prize.
nurse:quiz.option.resultText.fail: Bzzt! The answer is 8 hours or more. Early bedtime tonight.
staffroom:title: Staff Room
staffroom:text: Your homeroom teacher calls you in to sort out everything that's piled up so far.
staffroom:rules.scholarship.text: You've earned an academic merit scholarship! The teacher handed you an envelope.
staffroom:rules.award.text: The teacher gathered up all your certificates and prize money. Your name is in the trophy case!
staffroom:rules.praise.text: “You've been working hard lately.” Along with the praise, you got some snack money for running an errand.
staffroom:rules.late.text: You got a long lecture for being late so often. Time to show up early starting tomorrow.
staffroom:rules.none.text: You and the teacher chatted about life lately. Somehow, it makes you feel reassured.
